Variant of: Militech Crusher (Circa 207X)
Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)
Class: Shotgun
Range: Short Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Choke, Shotgun Rechamber, Sling, Tactical Light (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell

Darkhound variant: a Barghest-modified version of the listed original. It ablates 1 extra SP whenever it would ablate armor. Ammo bought for it costs double, is one Price Category higher, and only fits the weapon it was bought for. Unless stated here, it keeps the original's rules.

Fired with the Handgun skill. Shotgun Shells deal 4d6 (Shotgun Rechamber).

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog > Variants).
